status: APPROVED 2026-10-04 by the author through the instruction to continue with the proposed Gate 0
purpose: Determine whether fixed automatic Q/R/S/T targets are sufficiently complete and repeatable to supervise a structured clinical-event head before any model training is authorised.
input: All 16682 unique ECG windows in the audited MMECG 8-second subject pool; radar/WSST tensors are not read.
label_algorithm: NeuroKit2 0.2.12 prominence; independent ECG cleaning, R detection and delineation in every 8-second window at 200 Hz.
repeatability: For consecutive overlapping windows from the same record, convert fiducials to record-absolute samples, restrict to the common support after 300-ms edge exclusion, and obtain an order-preserving maximum-cardinality match within 150 ms. Repeatability error is the absolute difference between matched locations.
physiological_order: A beat is assessable only when Q, R, S and T are all finite; a violation is any beat not satisfying Q < R < S < T.
aggregation: Compute sufficient counts and error samples per subject, then report both pooled and subject-macro summaries over the 11 subjects. Repeated overlapping observations are diagnostics of label repeatability, not independent clinical observations.

gate_locked_before_results.completeness: For each of Q/R/S/T, subject-median within-window availability >= 0.90 and no subject below 0.80.
gate_locked_before_results.repeatability: For each of Q/R/S/T, subject-median matched repeatability coverage >= 0.90, subject-median MedAE <= 10 ms, and subject-median P95 <= 20 ms.
gate_locked_before_results.ordering: Subject-median Q<R<S<T violation rate <= 0.01 and no subject above 0.05.
gate_locked_before_results.decision: All clauses pass -> a separately specified three-fold Event-Head gate may be designed; otherwise stop and repair/redefine targets before model training. Passing establishes computational label learnability only, not clinical validity.

outputs: docs/audits/q1_event_label_learnability_v1/ plus a human-readable audit; atomic writes and source/data fingerprints.
constraints: CPU-only read-only evaluation; no GPU and no model predictions
no training, tuning, checkpoint access or test-set model selection
do not alter the public delineator validation or timing-screen artifacts
Q/S peak clinical validity remains unconfirmed even if this computational gate passes
